about_short_description.short_description: Pismo is a technology company providing an all-in-one processing platform for banking, payments, and financial markets infrastructure.

product.name: Core Banking
product.description: A cloud-native SaaS platform for retail, digital, and corporate banking operations, enabling fast innovation, scalability, and real-time transaction processing.

product.name: Card Issuing
product.description: A platform to issue and process credit, debit, prepaid, virtual, and one-time use cards for Visa, Mastercard, and private labels in real-time.

product.name: Digital Lending
product.description: A cloud-native solution for creating, managing, and scaling loan products with features like booking, disbursement, auto-repayment, and product return handling.

product.name: Digital Wallets
product.description: A platform to build proprietary digital wallets that manage buyers and sellers across devices and platforms, competing with major market wallets.

product.name: Seller Management
product.description: A system for merchants to process transactions, reconciliation, statements, payments, receivables financing, and manage charges, fees, and taxes in real-time.
